meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 装上后，当你要求时，Claude 会以只读方式分析当前 GitHub 仓库中所有开放的 issues 和 PRs，为每一项生成一份带证据链接的分析报告，并保存到 /tmp 文件夹中。它只生成报告，不会对 GitHub 进行任何修改操作。
howto.when: 当你说出“triage”、“triage issues”、“triage PRs”或“github triage”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 请帮我 triage 这个仓库的所有 issues。
say.note: Claude 会开始逐项分析并生成报告。

say.text: 分析最新的 PRs，给我一份 triage 报告。
say.note: Claude 只读取 PR 数据，不发表评论。

say.text: 对 GitHub 项目进行一次完整的 triage。
say.note: Claude 会处理所有开放 issues 和 PRs。

howto.what_en: When activated, Claude reads all open issues and PRs of the current GitHub repository, analyzes each one, and writes an evidence-backed report to /tmp/. It never modifies anything on GitHub — comments, labels, merges, or closures are forbidden.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', or 'github triage'.

say_en.text: Please triage all open issues in this repo.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes each issue and writes reports.

say_en.text: Analyze the latest PRs and produce a triage report.
say_en.note: Claude reads PR data only; no actions taken.

say_en.text: Run a full triage on the GitHub project.
say_en.note: Claude processes all open issues and PRs.
